maddeler.e:
نختبر (form VIII)
# نَخْتَبِرُ (naḵtabiru) /nax.ta.bi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
# نُخْتَبَرُ (nuḵtabaru) /nux.ta.ba.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
# نَخْتَبِرَ (naḵtabira) /nax.ta.bi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَبَرَ (iḵtabara)
# نُخْتَبَرَ (nuḵtabara) /nux.ta.ba.ra/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
